The following will be in the Card/Board Game area:

Fri 1pm - 9pm
VTES World of Darkness Draft
Description: V:EKN-sanctioned booster draft tournament. A mixed (but fixed)
assortment of 8 boosters per player. Two rounds plus a final (2.5 hour
final round starts at 6pm). Additional Master: Discipline cards will be
provided, up to 2 per player.

Sat 9am - 6pm
VTES Dragon's Breath Tournament
Description: V:EKN-sanctioned constructed deck tournament. Three rounds
plus a final (the final round starts at 5pm)

Sun 9am - 12noon
V:TES Demo and Rapid Thought Tournaments
Description: Demos for new players and continuous 9-player Rapid Thought
tournaments as they fill up. Rapid Thought format follows standard V:EKN
rules except that each round is 45 minutes, libraries must be 60 cards, and
the banned list is extended to include the following cards: Minion Tap,
Blood Doll, and Tribute to the Master.

Sun 1pm - 8pm
VTES Create-A-Clan Tournament
Description: Unsanctioned constructed deck tournament. Create your own
vampires for your 12-card crypt. See construction parameters at
http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/cac.html

Mon 9am - 4pm
V:TES BYO Sealed
Bring your own mix-n-match selection of 9 booster packs from any WW sets
(11-card boosters only, that is). Additional Master: Discipline cards will
be provided, up to 2 per player. Remember: the grouping rule is not used in
sealed deck tournaments. Two rounds plus a final (the final round starts at
2pm)
